review.scope: Source-only review at commit 16c9f4d6: bounded readiness scheduling (readiness_queue.py, job_store.py, readiness-stages.json), explicit proposal/evidence context (research_context.py), campaign authoring pipeline and unattended author profile (campaign_pipeline.py, agents-unattended.toml), scout.py orchestrator, and supplied tests. Checked concurrency, restart/recovery semantics, receipt and identity bindings, fail-closed boundaries, blinding, and preservation of legacy scientific approvals. No tests executed; no patient data or tools exercised.
findings: BLOCKER (authority boundary): research_context.proposal_context's PROPOSAL_SCOPE check is a string prefix test ('campaigns/isles24-pilot/pipeline/') while checked() only enforces containment in the repo root after resolve(); a relative path containing '..' (e.g. 'campaigns/isles24-pilot/pipeline/../../../ideas/x') bypasses the pipeline-directory boundary. Since only execute() writes receipts inside the pipeline dir, this lets a fabricated receipt.json + self-approved review.json written elsewhere (agents hold ideas/ write scope) be loaded as a 'reviewed charter proposal', which also suppresses the legacy prompt/rubric from authoring context. Require the resolved path to be relative_to the resolved pipeline directory and reject '..' segments.

BLOCKER (recovery semantics): in readiness_queue.run(), folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False) precedes q.claim(); a crash in that window leaves the job READY with a persistent attempt folder, and reconcile only blocks RUNNING jobs, so every subsequent run() re-selects the job and dies with an unhandled FileExistsError, wedging the entire queue instead of blocking one task. Same wedge for a job manually re-readied after HANDLER_FAILED while its folder remains. Treat an existing attempt folder without result.json as an uncertain attempt (block), or claim before mkdir and convert FileExistsError into a scoped block.

MINOR: run() ignores q.claim(name)'s return value; if claim ever returned None (blocked/retry-limited), the handler would still be submitted to the worker pool. Unreachable today (candidates yields only READY, due=0) but a latent invariant leak; check the claim result before dispatch.

MINOR: ReadinessQueue.accept() reads the job row (status/binding guard) before BEGIN IMMEDIATE, so the UNCLAIMED_RESULT check races the transaction; benign under the single-controller branch lock, but move the row read inside the transaction.

MINOR: Store.block() issues two autocommit statements (jobs UPDATE, inbox INSERT OR REPLACE); a crash between them leaves a BLOCKED job with no inbox entry — fail-closed but invisible to the human decision queue. Wrap in a transaction.

MINOR (provenance): campaign_pipeline.system_stage never removes its mkdtemp profile directory, swaps the process-global sc.ROOT (safe only single-threaded; assumption unstated), and the SCOUT_CI branch writes no profile_<stage>.json receipt, so profile provenance is asymmetric between local and hosted runs.

MINOR (provenance): scout.py _commit_all hardcodes committer identity 'Astra (OpenAI agent)' for every checkpoint commit regardless of which model family executed the stage; stage_provenance.jsonl receipts remain authoritative, but commit metadata misattributes authorship.

MINOR (cross-charter targeting): stage_target's legacy 'scout' path selects the lexically last ideas/scout-* directory; charter-prefixed names (e.g. scout-isles24-001) sort after numeric baseline names, so 'run --stage scout' can silently target another charter's cycle directory.

VERIFIED SOUND: missing receipts treated as uncertainty with no automatic retry; immutable result reconciliation deduplicates with CONFLICTING_COMPLETION on divergence; handlers are a fixed metadata-only whitelist (no model, patient, Git-writer, or arbitrary-command execution) with symlink/containment checks; gated launch/import tasks fail closed into the inbox; results/attempts are identity-bound to job name, binding, and source pin with MIXED_SOURCE_QUEUE refusal; evidence_context withholds pending conclusions and hash-binds reviewed ones; campaign execute() enforces opposing-family author/reviewer receipts, rejects pre-populated reviewer output, writes only into fresh exist_ok=False pipeline output dirs, and preserves historical charters, scores, P001 frozen artifacts, and deliberate blinding; charter adoption and patient launch remain separately gated operator decisions.

review.scope: Follow-up (r2) to readiness review r1 REQUEST_CHANGES: verify repaired proposal-directory traversal and READY-with-attempt crash window plus minor fixes per READINESS_REVIEW_REPAIRS_20260906; assess remaining material correctness/privacy/authority defects in the new non-patient readiness queue and proposed research context. Source-only; no tests executed; no scientific ratification or patient launch in scope.
findings: VERIFIED: proposal traversal repair — proposal_context rejects '..' parts, absolute paths, and non-contained resolved candidates before loading any receipt; checked() independently enforces symlink rejection (leaf and intermediates), resolved containment, size cap, and hash binding; receipt status/mode, frozen CAMPAIGN.md/P001 input hashes, round artifact hashes, and APPROVE review verdict are all enforced; disposition stays preview-only and unratified. Regression test covers parent traversal.

VERIFIED: crash-window repair — startup reconcile blocks any attempt-without-result (RUNNING status or existing attempt folder) as UNCERTAIN with no automatic retry while independent tasks remain eligible; claim precedes dispatch and a FileExistsError on the attempt folder blocks instead of replaying; recovery re-verifies attempt binding and deterministic result content (seconds=0 recompute) before idempotent acceptance; completion events dedupe by canonical payload equality and conflicting completions abort loudly.

VERIFIED: minor fixes — accept/claim read state inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE and block() is transaction-aware standalone or nested; system_stage cleans its temporary profile directory in finally and is documented single-writer (unreachable from readiness worker threads); legacy unqualified stage_target selects the latest baseline cycle only; automated checkpoints commit under a neutral system identity with model authorship carried on stage receipts.

VERIFIED: fail-closed/authority boundaries — gated launch/import tasks are blocked into the inbox and no handler can execute them; MIXED_SOURCE_QUEUE, 32-task bound, 40-hex source pin, and exact binding schema enforced; pending evidence exposes only id/tags/dependencies; reviewed conclusions require hash-bound AGENT_REVIEWED_NOT_HUMAN_RATIFIED receipts; execute() confines writes to the pipeline directory and never claims ratification.

NON-BLOCKING: proposal_context accepts a directory containing both receipt.json and blocked.json — a pair no legitimate execute() run can produce (receipt only on APPROVE, blocked.json only on failure), leaving a conditional forged-receipt acceptance path if any writer plants a self-consistent receipt in a failed run's directory. Recommend refusing when blocked.json exists and asserting output/receipt.json absent before author rounds; currently mitigated by stage write scoping.
NON-BLOCKING: restart reconcile overwrites a HANDLER_FAILED inbox reason with the generic UNCERTAIN_ATTEMPT reason (diagnostic loss only; no-retry guarantee unaffected).

NON-BLOCKING: a result.json missing a projection key raises bare KeyError rather than the named RESULT_SCHEMA error, and a COMPLETE job whose result.json was deleted but whose folder remains is re-marked BLOCKED despite its durable completion event — both fail closed but with an unnamed abort and a status/event divergence respectively.

NOTE: proposal_context re-verifies only CAMPAIGN.md and P001 frozen artifacts from the receipt's input_sha256; other bound inputs may drift without invalidating the preview — acceptable for preview-only context, worth documenting.
ASSUMPTION: identifier, lock, checked_source, immutable, and encoded (remote_supervisor/hosted_cycle) were not supplied and are assumed to be the previously reviewed implementations.
